The UGC Ads workflow is designed for videos around one minute or less; longer 5- or 10-minute videos are unsupported. Some language subtitle gaps .   Subtitles are not supported for several listed languages, including Hindi, Arabic, Urdu, Hebrew, Thai, and Farsi.
